display_name: DURA 源非线性残差可预测性诊断
description: 比较源拟合线性与三次复 IQ 特征对按物理 ID 留出样本的 DURA 残差解释能力。

data.dataset: Phase1 Main split permitted source L_s/U_s
data.representation: 32768 source physical fit IDs x three paired received/DURA/clean IQ views; 28672 IDs fit, 4096 IDs held out

permissions.claim_scope: Held-out source IQ NMSE only; no saved filter, target accuracy, deployment or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed source-only DURA outputs from existing approved IQ context, no learned model checkpoint
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source context schema, source view order, distinct 32768 source fit IDs and no F/TX/V/target
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original DURA and source IQ context are F/TX/V/target free
checkpoint.selection_rule: Predefined linear and cubic global/four fixed source-noise-quartile regressions, ridge 0.001; no target selection

expected_artifacts: result.json: held-out source IQ NMSE, record counts, linear and cubic global/four source-noise bins

metric_names: records improved vs DURA and vs linear

rows.method: Global and noise-conditioned complex linear vs cubic residual
rows.purpose: Evaluate nonlinear source-IQ residual predictability, without per-record clean calibration
rows.seed_notes: No new randomness; deterministic source physical-ID-index modulo 8 split
rows.scenario: 28672 source IDs fit, 4096 source IDs held out, each with three simulated views
expected_artifacts: result.json: held-out source IQ NMSE, record counts, linear and cubic global/four source-noise bins

notes: Compare four complex linear terms and twelve linear-plus-cubic terms in time domain.
Both regressions use source-clean-energy normalized residual loss; inference features use received and DURA IQ.
Noise quartiles estimated only on fit records; no source record crosses fit and holdout.
Only source IQ; DURA may have seen these source IDs. Coefficients are not saved and IQ NMSE is not TX accuracy.
